VBO:0200478.summary: In Nordic hunting, elkhounds form a large-game working category. Norwegian kennel-club guidance includes the grey and black Norwegian Elkhounds, Jämthund and several Laikas, with different breeds used for tracking on a leash or working loose.
VBO:0200478.shortDescription: In Nordic hunting, elkhounds track large game on a leash or work loose; the category spans several breeds.
